name: deploy-bar
description: Small fixed measurement seed for the DEPLOY bar. Each case is a self-contained stress input; the prompt-under-test is supplied as the system prompt and run against a live model via efficacy-replay's `corpus` mode. The expect/reject regexes encode the behaviors the DEPLOY bar previously LINTED with stdlib regex over the prompt TEXT (has_structure, no_hedges, no_filler, has_edge_cases) — now MEASURED against real model output with a Wilson 95% CI. Add per-domain corpora alongside this one using the same schema when a prompt family needs domain-representative cases.
control_system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer the user's request directly.

cases.input: Compare three approaches to caching in a web service and recommend one.
Should a small team ship a feature behind a flag or wait for full QA? Give a clear answer.
Parse this into a date: ''. If the input is empty or invalid, say so explicitly.
List two risks of using global mutable state. Be concise.
